notes: Rameez's own phone footage of the pendant (IMG_7752, IMG_7753), asked for a stylish dark-theme quick reel. Source is HEVC 10-bit HLG — tonemapped to SDR before anything else, or the whole thing reads washed-out grey. The opening shot runs 1.5 beats rather than 1 because the hook-timing gate rejected 0.92 s on screen. Nine hard cuts out of two 7-second clips by going back to each at a different second; hard cuts, no dissolves, because a dissolve at 1.16 s reads as a mistake. Dark look is the new `noir` style. Its own track (music7-noir, ElevenLabs, 103.4 BPM measured by system/beatgrid.py, so the cut is 1.16 s = 2 beats). NO price, NO specs, NO material claim beyond what the footage shows — the Shopify handle for this fixture is unconfirmed, so nothing product-specific can be asserted yet. Second pass: every shot carries its own camera move (pull / push_hard / hold / drift_back) and shot 4 runs in reverse — without that, cutting between two clips of the same wall at the same distance read as one continuous pan rather than nine cuts. Text plates switched off: on this grade the auto box reads as a smudge.
